backup.production_rule: staff_signin_list_v2() is replaced in place (same signature and grants): kind is 'pin' when auth app_metadata.signin_kind = 'pin' or the e-mail is @staff.cascade.invalid, else 'password'. One data change: app_metadata.signin_kind = 'pin' on the single admin whose display_name is Lloyd (guarded lookup, the migration aborts unless exactly one row matches). Re-running is harmless. restore_point is a placeholder: the release block fills it (fill-restore-point.mjs).
backup.notes: Deploy order: SQL, then the staff-users edge function (it writes signin_kind on every PIN or password change). The Staff app already reads kind and needs no change. No new secret. Precondition: Cascade-Staff v3.4.3 (cs-shell-v28, with the 'Use a password instead' fallback) is live before this SQL is applied.

forward_verification.name: v2_body_is_the_s89_one
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '903c4e6b40fa2d24aa42f0fb14789797' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: v2_signature_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_result('public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure) = 'TABLE(label text, handle text, kind text, team text)'

forward_verification.name: v2_definer_with_an_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and proconfig @> array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: anon_and_authenticated_can_execute_and_public_cannot
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()', 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: one_row_per_active_profile
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.staff_signin_list_v2()) = (select count(*) from public.staff_access_profiles p join auth.users u on u.id = p.user_id where p.disabled_at is null and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until <= now()) and u.email is not null and u.email <> '')

forward_verification.name: lloyd_admin_is_pin_in_metadata_and_in_the_list
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from auth.users u join public.staff_access_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id where u.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'display_name' = 'Lloyd' and p.role = 'admin' and u.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'signin_kind' = 'pin') = 1 and (select count(*) from public.staff_signin_list_v2() v join auth.users u on lower(u.email) = v.handle where u.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'display_name' = 'Lloyd' and v.kind = 'pin' and v.team = 'admin') = 1

forward_verification.name: every_pin_row_is_metadata_or_staff_domain
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.staff_signin_list_v2() v join auth.users u on lower(u.email) = v.handle where v.kind = 'pin' and coalesce(u.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'signin_kind', '') <> 'pin' and v.handle not like '%@staff.cascade.invalid')

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback restores the s88 function body and removes the signin_kind key; the PIN password in Auth is untouched.

steps.name: verify_s88_body_back
steps.action: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'a84583ced05605ce51bf75307abff2f4' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure must be true, and no auth.users row has app_metadata signin_kind.

feature_flags.name: none
feature_flags.required_state: None. The Staff app already reads kind from v2.

compatibility.evidence: Same signature and grants; kind only turns to pin for rows that were password before, and only when signin_kind = pin. The staff-users edge function may be deployed before or after the SQL: an unknown app_metadata key is ignored by every reader.
